weight_mapping: Project inputs/outputs are unweighted h in increasing x. HOPPET receives x*h in increasing y=-ln(x); non-delta kernel pieces include the additional z Jacobian. Conversion occurs exactly once on each side.

time_mapping.tau: integral_Q02^Q2 alpha_s(q2)/(2*pi) dln(q2), computed in Julia using the selected contracted coupling
time_mapping.step_setting: The pinned ev_evolve omits optional du when calling ev_SetModuleConsts. SetDefaultEvolutionDu(du) is therefore applied under the isolated construction lock, then the previous DefaultEvolutionDu is restored. Test that changing du measurably changes the coarse result and converges.
time_mapping.meaning: An auxiliary constant-coupling interval solves the identical autonomous fixed-nf LO equation exp(tau*P). Auxiliary scales/coupling are not physical inputs or a substitute running-coupling prescription.

discretization.grid: single or locked nested uniform y grids; x=exp(-y); h(1)=0; no extrapolation below exp(-ymax)
discretization.declared_boundary: The caller may supply xmin (or ymax, exclusively). The final native x is the exact declared Float64 xmin and ymax=-log(xmin). This canonicalizes only the domain endpoint after the log/exp round trip, not interior knots, source values or acceptance tests. Queries at xmin are admitted; nextfloat toward zero is rejected.

nested_grid.locking: Use upstream InitGridDef(...,locked=true), including its declared rounding of native subgrid extents/steps. Return the sorted union of exact native x values; shared nodes use their finest native representation. Preserve distinct floating point knots.

discretization.order: negative HOPPET interpolation order, default -6; supported -2 through -10
discretization.cache: One retained HOPPET scalar grid_conv per supplied fixed tau, extracted from the nonsinglet evolution operator; no dense x-by-x operator cache
discretization.construction: config/hoppet-batch-contract.json selects batched_probes by default and retains independent construction as an explicit reference. Both evaluate each supplied tau without scale interpolation.
discretization.identity: tau=0 is an explicit identity on the constrained endpoint subspace
discretization.adjoint: Each native negative-order subgrid has C^T=R*C*R. Transpose upstream locked-grid decanting in reverse assignment order; transpose exact node gather/select and x-weight conversions; remove the h(1) coordinate. Reuse upstream convolution on every native subgrid, with basis and dot-product checks; do not rewrite the forward solver.
discretization.evaluation: Upstream EvalGridQuant interpolates the weighted x*h; divide by the requested x once. Queries are fixed coordinates, with strict support checks.
discretization.scale_interpolation: Not implicit: only supplied fixed scales are evaluated. Any later interpolation needs its own refinement checks.

derivatives.coordinates: Initial ordinates/physical shape parameters only; all operator settings are fixed
derivatives.method: Julia explicitly batches primal and ForwardDiff tangent components through the same fixed linear Float64 ABI; supports nested duals only after Hessian checks
derivatives.settings: Reject AD in grid, coupling, scales, tau, order, nf and solver tolerances; a fitted setting requires dU

native_precision.holder_initialization: The project adapter allocates one fixed-nf LO dglap_holder using the pinned public derived types, SetNfDglapHolder and zero InitSplitMat. Initialize its three unused coefficient headers explicitly with HO=false and delta=0. Insert the unchanged transversity kernel only. Do not first construct and discard unpolarized LO splitting functions.
native_precision.retained_algorithms: Keep the exact grids, solver eps/du, constrained endpoint, transversity/Collins kernels, coupling, evolution, convolution, interpolation, batched probes and adjoints. No external source or acceptance threshold changes.
native_precision.diagnostic_guard: Julia serializes native operations and stderr redirection under HOPPET_NATIVE_LOCK, flushes C stdio, replays native stderr, and rejects TOO HIGH ACCURACY REQUIRED even when the native ABI status is zero. Register a returned native context before checking diagnostics so a rejected constructor closes it. Never silently retry with looser settings or another backend.

validation_policy.scope: Reject native diagnostic failures; compare retained fixed-grid predictions bit-for-bit against the parent adapter, then run unchanged component/process refinements. Synthetic zero-status error injection must reject and release its native context. This does not certify arbitrary kinematics or production physics.

native_precision.historical_limitations: Earlier declared comparisons remain recorded together with their native precision warnings. A new zero-error run cannot rewrite those runs or grant a uniform endpoint/native-accuracy certificate. The STAR common-grid endpoint limitation remains open.

state: One active context per loaded bridge, guarded by generation handles and a Julia process lock. Numerical jobs remain isolated processes; upstream SAVE/global state is not claimed thread-safe.

validation_policy.scope: same-equation analytic/Mellin, fixed-grid, AD and resource pilots; not production G2/G2AD/G2PERF
validation_policy.analytic_input: h0=x*(1-x)^3, plus signed/scaled and affine initial columns
validation_policy.retained_backend_speed: Measure cold preparation, warm batched application and stored payload at matching accuracy; informational until a physical workload and frozen G2PERF policy are admitted.

remaining: physical input interpolation/refinement and scalable many-scale matching assembly
publication observables and physical process fixtures
